title: Train Classify

read.description: Read the training data for a Classify Wrangle

write.description: Train a new or existing Classify Wrangle

name.description: Name to give to a new Wrangle that will be created

model_id.description: Model to be updated. Either this or a name must be provided

description: Read the training data for a Classify Wrangle
guidance:
### Read #### Recipe ```yaml read: - train.classify: model_id: xxxxxxxx-xxxx-xxxx ``` ##### Output
| Example | Category | Notes | | :------ | :------- | :---- | | Apple | Fruit | | | Broccoli | Vegetable | | | Pear | Fruit | | | Aperagus | Vegetable | |
#### Function ```python from wrangles.connectors import train df = train.classify.read(model_id = 'xxxxxxxx-xxxx-xxxx') ``` ##### Output
| Example | Category | Notes | | :------ | :------- | :---- | | Apple | Fruit | | | Broccoli | Vegetable | | | Pear | Fruit | | | Asperagus | Vegetable | |
### Write #### Recipe Update the training data for an existing classify wrangle. ```yaml write: - train.classify: columns: - Example - Category - Notes model_id: xxxxxxxx-xxxx-xxxx ``` #### Function Create a new classify wrangle. ```python from wrangles.connectors import train import pandas as pd df = pd.DataFrame({ 'Example': ['Apple', 'Broccoli', 'Pear', 'Asperagus'], 'Category': ['Fruit', 'Vegitable', 'Fruit', 'Vegitable'], 'Notes': ['', '', '', ''] }) train.classify.write(df = df, name = 'Fruits and Veggies') ``` > Note both name and model_id **cannot** be used together. Name is used when creating models and model_id is used when updating an existing model.
